entities.summary: Pavel Maykov (b. 1975-10-15, Mytishchi) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Mytishchi and Russia. Known in the fields of russia, composers & musicians, europe.
